entityId.description: The ID of the entity used by the {@link DataDiagnostic} when evaluating its logic.

start.description: The start of the evaluation of the {@link DataDiagnostic#metricExpression} when validating its logic.

end.description: The start of the evaluation of the {@link DataDiagnostic#metricExpression} when validating its logic.

bindings.description: The bindings used during the evaluation of the {@link DataDiagnostic} when validating its logic.

triggersAction.description:
Whether or not the {@link DataDiagnostic} evaluation results in some positive action being taken
based on the other arguments supplied in this spec.

For example, the entity is tagged or an alert is created.

title: Type used as an argument to the validation functions of {@link DataDiagnostic}s.
